title: T94 PNC - Zachar Chasdo (Worlds Created for Israel/Shechinah in Each Person, 2 segs)
hebrewTitle: זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ — כָּל הָעוֹלָמוֹת בִּשְׁבִיל יִשְׂרָאֵל
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: Opening verse: 'He remembered His kindness and His faith to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God' (Psalms 98:3).

intermediate.en: Frame verse: Teh 98:3. Hashem remembered His chesed and emunah to the house of Israel; all ends of earth saw the salvation.
intermediate.he: פָּסוּק: תה' צ"ח:ג. הַשֵּׁם זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל; כָּל אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ רָאוּ יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ.

beginner.en: The matter is: all the worlds were created solely for the sake of Israel. As the verse says: 'For My glory I created it, I formed it, even I made it' (Isaiah 43:7) — the three acts of beri'ah (creation), yetzirah (formation), and asiyah (making) were brought into being solely for 'My glory.' And 'My glory' refers to Israel. As the verse says: 'And I will dwell among them' (Exodus 25:8). The Sages expounded (Shelah, Masecheta Ta'anit, 60a): The verse does not say 'among him' but 'among them' — teaching that the Shechinah rests within each and every individual among Israel.

intermediate.en: All worlds created for Israel. Yesh 43:7: beri'ah/yetzirah/asiyah for 'My glory' = Israel. Shemot 25:8 'V'shachanti betocham.' Shelah, Ta'anit 60a: 'betocham' (plural) = Shechinah rests within each individual.
intermediate.he: כָּל הָעוֹלָמוֹת נִבְרְאוּ בִּשְׁבִיל יִשְׂרָאֵל. יְשַׁ' מ"ג:ז: בְּרִיאָה/יְצִירָה/עֲשִׂיָּה לִ'כְבוֹדִי' = יִשְׂרָאֵל. שְׁמ' כ"ה:ח 'וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם.' שֶׁלָ"ה, תַּעֲנִית ס:: 'בְּתוֹכָם' (רַבִּים) = שְׁכִינָה שׁוֹרָה בְּכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד.

scholarly.he: יְשַׁ' מ"ג:ז; שְׁמ' כ"ה:ח; שֶׁלָ"ה תַּעֲנִית ס:.
